736:t_1:86.en:
$$トロワ$$
「If there's no one, then we can do it ourselves.」

736:t_1:87.en:
$$五飛$$
「This life... I dedicated it long ago to become a foundation of peace.」

736:t_1:88.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Yeah! That's a soldier's duty too!」

736:t_1:89.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Fighting the enemies who threaten peace is our job.」

736:t_1:90.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(Our late friend, $$グラハム・エーカー$$, would surely have said the same.)

736:t_1:91.en:
$$ノイン$$
「And the peace we win will be protected by $$リリーナ$$ and the others.」

736:t_1:92.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That is why we must win. Against the $$御使い$$s, and against the universe's great collapse.」

736:t_1:94.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$ヒイロ$$... What will you do when the fighting is over?」

736:t_1:97.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What do you intend to do?」

736:t_1:98.en:
$$刹那$$
「If I can make it through this battle...」

736:t_1:99.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm thinking of going to the home planet of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

736:t_1:101.en:
$$刹那$$
「The thing we gained in this battle... I want to confirm once more what it means to understand each other... The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are where I'll start.」

736:t_1:102.en:
$$刹那$$
「And if we really have grasped the truth of the universe, I want to create something new with it.」

736:t_1:103.en:
$$刹那$$
「Even if it takes years... or decades.」

736:t_1:105.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I want to know what new thing you create, too.」

736:t_1:108.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Were you thinking about $$ミネバ$$?」

736:t_1:109.en:
$$バナージ$$
「For me, it's $$オードリー$$.」

736:t_1:110.en:
$$バナージ$$
「And for the sake of my promise to her, I'll be sure to seize the future and return to Earth.」

736:t_1:112.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What should change, changes... What doesn't need to change, doesn't... I think that's fine.」

736:t_1:113.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「That's right. That's your strength, I suppose.」

736:t_1:115.en:
$$リディ$$
「Were you thinking about $$ミネバ$$?」

736:t_1:116.en:
$$バナージ$$
「For me, it's $$オードリー$$.」

736:t_1:117.en:
$$バナージ$$
「And for the sake of my promise to her, I'll be sure to seize the future and return to Earth.」

736:t_1:119.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What should change, changes... What doesn't need to change, doesn't... I think that's fine.」

736:t_1:120.en:
$$バナージ$$
(That's right, isn't it, $$マリーダ$$...)

736:t_1:121.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「That $$バナージ$$... Does he even realize this is the battle that decides the fate of every parallel world...?」

736:t_1:122.en:
$$クェス$$
「Jealous, $$ギュネイ$$? Of $$バナージ$$, who has someone waiting for him?」

736:t_1:123.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'd rather have $$クェス$$, who fights by my side.」

736:t_1:124.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「...If you're like that, you're in no position to say anything about $$バナージ$$, are you...?」

736:t_1:125.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Don't say that, $$ハサウェイ$$.」

736:t_1:126.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Lover, family, anyone will do. Having something to protect makes a man stronger.」

736:t_1:127.en:
$$クェス$$
「It's no different for women. Right... Lieutenant $$エマ$$?」

736:t_1:128.en:
$$エマ$$
「That's right. We have to do our best too, for the people waiting for us on Earth.」

736:t_1:129.en:
$$クェス$$
「Lucky $$バナージ$$... Having someone waiting for him.」

736:t_1:130.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Am I no good, $$クェス$$?」

736:t_1:133.en:
$$クェス$$
「Having someone waiting for you is nice, but I just thought having someone right beside you like this is nice too.」

736:t_1:135.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Once you can get a woman to say that much, you're a full-fledged man, $$ハサウェイ$$.」

736:t_1:136.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Having something to protect makes a man stronger.」

736:t_1:137.en:
$$クェス$$
「It's no different for women. Right... Lieutenant $$エマ$$?」

736:t_1:138.en:
$$エマ$$
「That's right. We have to do our best too, for the sake of the people waiting for us on Earth.」

736:t_1:139.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...Everyone is less tense than I expected.」

736:t_1:140.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We've come this far, so there's nothing left to do but fight. It's better to psych ourselves up by thinking about victory than to cower at the thought of defeat.」

736:t_1:141.en:
$$シャア$$
「A battle for the future of humanity... in all the parallel worlds...」

736:t_1:142.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Something on your mind, it seems?」

736:t_1:143.en:
$$シャア$$
「If we get through this battle, will we grasp the truth and go on to undergo $$シンカ$$...?」

736:t_1:144.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「And become what they call higher-dimensional life forms... is that it...?」

736:t_1:145.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...Humans aren't that convenient a kind of being...」

736:t_1:147.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's true that the road to evolution has opened, but that doesn't mean people will change overnight.」

736:t_1:148.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Surely that will take a long time yet... as long as it took us to evolve from ape-men into humans...」

736:t_1:149.en:
$$シャア$$
「It looks like we won't live to see where humanity is headed.」

736:t_1:150.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But I do feel that we're standing at its entrance. That's enough.」

736:t_1:151.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All that's left is to live believing there's something beyond it. And to overcome those who would stand in the way.」

736:t_1:152.en:
$$シャア$$
「To that end, let us stake our lives. Together with those who believe.」

736:t_1:154.en:
$$シャア$$
「I told you, $$ハマーン$$. I won't leave you behind again.」

736:t_1:156.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Believe... Surely that will give us strength... the strength to open up the future...)

736:t_1:157.en:
$$アムロ$$
(There is light beyond that... Isn't that so, $$ララァ$$...)

736:t_1:160.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If every human could do that, conflict would disappear from this world too.」

736:t_1:161.en:
$$カレン$$
「They can, $$ゼロ$$. Because that's how we've been fighting all along.」

736:t_1:162.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「But it will take a considerable amount of time for every human being to attain the truth.」

736:t_1:163.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「In the meantime, some worthless people are sure to show up.」

736:t_1:164.en:
$$マオ$$
「So our fight goes on, dealing with that sort of crowd. Is that it?」

736:t_1:165.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Otherwise, it'd be a bit of a problem. If the world suddenly became perfectly peaceful, we'd be completely out of work.」
